note: The SSML input controls the say-as mode through the interpret-as attribute.
The chosen say-as mode is encoded into the output stream and later consumed when the tag closes.
The close-tag path assumes the mode still identifies a key-name payload before rewriting the buffered text.
The buffered text is re-read from the earlier output position; if the buffer contents/lifetime are inconsistent, this becomes a use-after-free style read of stale data.
